title: attacks.json
description: FROZEN CONTRACT v0. Output of Pillar 1 (Identify), input to the Simulator. Source: AI_Defense_Lab_Strategy.pdf S4.4, plus three additions agreed 2026-08-20 (source as object, expected_levels, holdout).

vector_id.description: Stable identifier. Never reused, never renumbered.

chain.description: Ordered primitive names. Must exist in contracts/grammar.json and satisfy its composition_rules. Enforced by validate_chain(), not by this schema.

data_signature.description: Prose description of the observable footprint. This is what the detector is expected to see.

parameters.description: Sampling ranges the simulator draws from. Keys are primitive-specific.

source.description: Real cited incident grounding this vector. Rendered as a card in the prototype, so it must be an object and not a bare string.

case.description: One-line description of the real incident.

doc_ref.description: Where in the supplied source documents this came from, e.g. '33_AI_Era_Frauds #16' or 'Research_Backed_Plan S2'.

regulator_advisory.description: RBI / NPCI / CERT-In reference where one exists. PDF S4.3 prioritises these over news coverage.

expected_levels.description: Which detector level is predicted to catch this. Stated in advance so the S6.1 ablation tests a prediction rather than narrating a result.

holdout.description: family = whole vector withheld from training (S6.3). composition = chain built from seen primitives in an unseen order.

generation.description: 0 for hand-authored. Incremented by the red-team strategist.

parent_vector_id.description: Set when produced by mutation of an existing vector.

mutation_mode.description: Which S7.1 mutation mode produced this vector.

narrative.description: LLM-authored scenario text. Presentation and feature layer only (S5.1) - never the source of a number.
